cross_store.treatment: All lawful attributions remain in the interval; no venue is selected for finance.

coverage_and_reserve.recommendation: Reserve the hard upper end. The packet has no mature evidence for abandonment in the unsupported strata, so a point estimate is not a recognized liability.

historical_support.interpretation: B1 supplies mature evidence for transfer, pause extension and cross-store redemption. B2 has cutoff-only and rectified experience; B3 has no mature outcome, so its unobserved behavior is not treated as breakage.

warning: Weekly gross_min/gross_max are marginal bounds over mutually exclusive coherent scenarios. Do not sum all weekly minima or all weekly maxima as one balance; use coherent_scenarios for joint totals.
